text:
PROFILE::serverssl
Description
Returns the current value of the specified setting in the assigned
Server SSL profile.
Syntax
PROFILE
::
serverssl
<
setting_name
>
PROFILE::serverssl <setting_name>
Returns the current value of the specified setting in the assigned
Server SSL profile.
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
if
{[
PROFILE
::
exists
serverssl
]
==
1
}{
log
local0.
"server SSL profile enabled: [PROFILE::serverssl name]"
}
}
Related Information
